title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.45
body_markdown:
* Added: Preview of Agent mode with support for MCP tools. Requires enabling Editor Preview Features in Copilot settings.
* Fixed: Resolved authorization issue. If an unexpected Authorize button appears in the chat panel, logging out and back in will fix it.
* Fixed: Addressed IDE freezing in certain rare scenarios.
* Fixed: Commit message generation now includes the current Git branch name as context.
* Fixed: Enhanced user experience, including improved rendering of code blocks.
